title: Unbekannter schießt auf 27-Jährigen – BAO Ferrum und Ermittlungsgruppe Telum ermitteln

extraction.summaryEn: A 27-year-old man was grazed in the leg by a bullet in Anita-Berber-Park after a group confronted him and a companion, one of them with a pistol. Police are investigating the shooting as an attempted homicide.
